summary: #edu407 This is a good example of an holistic rubric. Notice a score is compromises multiple criterion. As a teacher you weigh them all against each other and usually an anchor set of quality. I prefer holistic rubrics for teaching writing (criterion based useful in measuring....not so much teaching IMO)
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: #edu407 This is a good example of an holistic rubric. Notice a score is compromises multiple criterion. As a teacher you weigh them all against each other and usually an anchor set of quality. I prefer holistic rubrics for teaching writing (criterion based useful in measuring....not so much teaching IMO)
